mappings.note: Contains only the superscription (title) 'To the choir director... A psalm of David' which is not present in OSMAIN v1 text body. OSMAIN includes this title as part of verse 1, but WLC separates it into its own verse 1.
Contains the prayer content ('Answer me when I call...') which corresponds to OSMAIN v1. The title in WLC v1 is missing from this verse.
Matches OSMAIN v2 ('O sons of men...'). The 'Sela' marker is present in both.
Matches OSMAIN v3 ('Know that the Lord has set apart...').
Matches OSMAIN v4 ('Be angry and do not sin...'). The 'Sela' marker is present in both.
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('Many say: Who will show us any good? Lift up the light of your face...').
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('You have put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and wine abound').
Matches OSMAIN v8 ('In peace I will lie down...'). The Hebrew text in WLC includes 'and sleep' (ve-eshan) which is explicitly translated as 'sove' in OSMAIN.

extraContent.description: Superscription/Title: 'To the choir director. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David.' This text is present as a header in OSMAIN v1 but separated into its own verse (v1) in WLC.
